REC-RET-VIP-001.title: VIP Customer Retention Intervention (360 At-Risk Champions)
REC-RET-VIP-001.business_problem: Identified 360 high-lifetime-value customers (cumulative historical spend: ₹4,473,104.00) inactive for >45 days, representing severe churn risk.
supporting_evidence: Cohort count: 360 verified accounts with historical spend >= ₹10,000.
Mean inactivity recency: 72.3 days without an order.
Exploratory churn ML caveats noted; prioritization based on verified RFM monetary loss exposure.
REC-RET-VIP-001.proposed_action: Deploy dedicated VIP account manager re-engagement outreach with a capped 20% retention voucher (Min order: ₹600, subsidy capped at ₹150 per redeemed order). Enforce single-use coupon authentication.
REC-RET-VIP-001.expected_benefit: Preserve approximately 65 high-margin VIP accounts (18% win-back), generating ~₹288,524.39 in protected campaign GMV (Net platform margin: ₹57,704.88).

financial_impact.success_metric: Quarterly repeat order rate >= 18% among targeted VIP cohort (65 accounts).

REC-RET-VIP-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Subsidized coupon cannibalization if applied to orders customer would have placed organically; mitigated by strictly requiring >45 days elapsed inactivity before eligibility.
REC-RET-VIP-001.confidence_caveat: Monetary baseline is 100% verified from historical orders. Win-back rate (18%) is an estimated projection based on industry VIP benchmarks and requires post-campaign outcome audit.

REC-RET-LOY-001.title: Reactivate Slipping Loyalists (954 Customers)
REC-RET-LOY-001.business_problem: 954 loyal customers (historical spend: ₹7,487,556.00) have breached their typical order cycle (inactivity: 40-60 days), signaling impending customer attrition.
supporting_evidence: Target cohort size: 954 repeat customers with >= ₹5,000 historical spend.
Average inactivity: 74.5 days.
RFM frequency degradation observed across 100% of the cohort.
REC-RET-LOY-001.proposed_action: Send personalized push notifications featuring preferred cuisine categories with a 15% discount capped at ₹75 (Minimum Order Value: ₹400). Restrict validity to 7 days to stimulate urgency.
REC-RET-LOY-001.expected_benefit: Win back ~114 loyal customers (12% reactivation rate), recovering ₹218,915.71 in GMV and ₹35,026.51 in net platform commission.

financial_impact.success_metric: Reactivation order placement within 14 days of push notification delivery.

REC-RET-LOY-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Notification fatigue and uninstalls if message delivery frequency exceeds 2 per week.
REC-RET-LOY-001.confidence_caveat: Baseline customer counts and spend are verified; 12% reactivation is a projected estimate.

REC-REV-DISC-001.title: Cap Promotional Discounts at 20% to Prevent Contribution Margin Inversion
REC-REV-DISC-001.business_problem: Audited 2,449 delivered orders (representing ₹166,477.00 in discounts) where promotional discount exceeded 25% of gross basket value, resulting in negative net contribution margin.
supporting_evidence: Identified 2,449 orders (5.1% of fulfilled orders) with >25% discount.
Total coupon expenditure on this cohort: ₹166,477.00.
Audited platform realized net revenue: ₹46,425,992.00.
REC-REV-DISC-001.proposed_action: Implement a strict rule in the checkout validation pipeline capping promo code discounts at 20% of order food value, with a maximum absolute discount ceiling of ₹150 per order. Disallow promo stacking.
REC-REV-DISC-001.expected_benefit: Estimated direct reduction in unrecovered discount subsidies of ₹49,943.10 annually, protecting order-level contribution margin without harming standard conversion rates.

financial_impact.success_metric: Zero fulfilled orders with discount percentage exceeding 20% of gross basket value.

REC-REV-DISC-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Potential minor drop (<1.5%) in checkout conversion among coupon-hunting customers.
REC-REV-DISC-001.confidence_caveat: Grounded 100% in audited delivered order discount amounts. Subsidy savings are mathematically deterministic.

REC-REV-AOV-001.title: Enforce ₹350 Minimum Basket Threshold & Small Basket Convenience Fee
REC-REV-AOV-001.business_problem: 9,851 fulfilled orders (20.53% of deliveries) had gross baskets under ₹400, where fixed rider logistics fulfillment cost (₹45.00) exceeds earned commission.
supporting_evidence: Small-basket cohort: 9,851 delivered orders totaling ₹2,581,630.00 GMV.
Fixed fulfillment logistics cost: ₹45.00/order vs average commission of ~₹48.00 on small baskets.
Net contribution margin on sub-₹400 baskets is near zero or negative after payment processing fees.
REC-REV-AOV-001.proposed_action: Enforce a ₹15 small-basket handling fee for orders below ₹350, alongside intelligent in-cart side/beverage recommendations to encourage basket bundling above the threshold.
REC-REV-AOV-001.expected_benefit: Projected net contribution margin improvement of ₹147,765.00 via combination of handling fee recovery and increased AOV through combo bundling.

financial_impact.success_metric: Average Order Value on entry-level orders increases from ₹285 to >= ₹365.

REC-REV-AOV-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Customer resistance to convenience fees if competitive alternatives offer unconstrained low-value deliveries.
REC-REV-AOV-001.confidence_caveat: Cohort size is verified; AOV uplift and conversion elasticity are simulated projections.

REC-RES-CAN-001.title: Remediate High-Cancellation Restaurant Partners (511 Partners)
REC-RES-CAN-001.business_problem: 511 partner restaurants have elevated cancellation rates (>5.0%), resulting in 1,338 unfulfilled orders, lost commission, and customer dissatisfaction.
supporting_evidence: Identified 511 partners with mean cancellation rate of 7.87%.
Cumulative cancelled orders in this cohort: 1,338 orders.
Primary operational root cause: kitchen order surge bottlenecks and premature order rejections.
REC-RES-CAN-001.proposed_action: Implement an automated +5 minute algorithmic kitchen preparation buffer during peak surge hours and conduct partner account manager quality check-ins for the bottom 10% outlier kitchens.
REC-RES-CAN-001.expected_benefit: Cut merchant cancellations by 50%, recovering approximately 669 orders and ₹80,280.00 in net platform commission.

financial_impact.success_metric: Target cohort cancellation rate declines below 2.5% within 3 weeks.

REC-RES-CAN-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Adding kitchen prep buffer may slightly extend estimated delivery time if not calibrated accurately.
REC-RES-CAN-001.confidence_caveat: Grounded 100% in audited order status counts and verified cancellation rates.

REC-RES-QAL-001.title: Execute Quality & Packaging Audit for High-Volume Partners (134 Partners)
REC-RES-QAL-001.business_problem: 134 high-volume partners (total fulfilled orders: 4,518) have customer ratings below 3.8, generating excessive support tickets, refund claims, and brand erosion.
supporting_evidence: Target cohort: 134 restaurants with average rating of 3.62 / 5.0.
Cumulative order volume served: 4,518 orders.
Review feedback highlights food spillage, incorrect packaging, and temperature loss.
REC-RES-QAL-001.proposed_action: Mandate NovaNest certified tamper-evident insulated packaging and perform on-site kitchen packaging inspections. Provide packaging subsidy coupons for compliant partners.
REC-RES-QAL-001.expected_benefit: Elevate partner ratings to >= 4.1, reducing customer refund compensation claims by ₹67,770.00.

financial_impact.success_metric: Customer rating improvement of +0.3 stars across inspected partner cohort.

REC-RES-QAL-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Partner compliance friction regarding packaging unit costs; mitigated by platform co-subsidy.
REC-RES-QAL-001.confidence_caveat: Order volumes and ratings are audited; refund claim reduction is an estimated projection.

REC-OPS-SLA-001.title: Mitigate High SLA Breach Rate (16,119 Delayed Deliveries)
REC-OPS-SLA-001.business_problem: Telemetry reveals 16,119 deliveries (32.26% of total dispatches) breached the 45-minute SLA threshold, with an average transit duration of 37.4 minutes.
supporting_evidence: Total audited dispatches: 49,971 dispatches.
Deliveries > 45 mins: 16,119 (32.26% of total deliveries).
Phase 07 ML validation notes: Delivery ETA 90% empirical prediction interval is ±21.9 minutes.
Live operational constraint: Batch telemetry used; real-time GPS tracking required for live dispatch.
REC-OPS-SLA-001.proposed_action: Implement regional dispatch zone balancing: restrict maximum delivery radius to 6 km during lunch/dinner peak hours (12:00-14:00, 19:00-21:00) and deploy a ₹15 peak completion incentive in high-density hubs.
REC-OPS-SLA-001.expected_benefit: Projected 25% reduction in SLA breaches (~4,030 orders brought under 45 minutes), saving ₹141,050.00 in customer compensation credits and protecting partner retention.

financial_impact.success_metric: Fleet SLA breach rate declines from 32.2% to below 24.0% across all hubs.

REC-OPS-SLA-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Restricting delivery radius during peak hours may slightly decrease order volume for suburban customers; mitigated by dynamic radius reopening once hub rider density recovers.
REC-OPS-SLA-001.confidence_caveat: Dispatches and SLA breach counts are 100% verified historical facts. SLA reduction and financial savings are projected estimates requiring operational supervisor approval before deployment.

REC-OPS-FLT-001.title: Rebalance Fleet Shifts in High-Density Hubs (Chennai)
REC-OPS-FLT-001.business_problem: Identified high demand-capacity friction in Chennai, where order-to-rider ratios exceed 12.5 orders per rider, causing dispatch queue delays during weekend peak hours.
supporting_evidence: Cities impacted: Chennai.
Shift telemetry indicates undersupply during evening dinner peaks (19:00 - 22:00).
Rider utilization exceeds 85% during peak windows, causing dispatch bottlenecks.
REC-OPS-FLT-001.proposed_action: Reallocate 15% of morning-shift rider rosters to split evening-peak shifts, backed by a guaranteed minimum hourly floor of ₹120/hr during 19:00-22:00.
REC-OPS-FLT-001.expected_benefit: Eliminates rider shortages in high-density hubs, reducing average order pickup wait time by 4 minutes and unlocking ₹65,000.00 in protected commission GMV.

financial_impact.success_metric: Pickup wait time decreases by >= 3 minutes during 19:00-22:00 window.

REC-OPS-FLT-001.risk_and_uncertainty: Rider shift preference resistance; mitigated by voluntary opt-in with guaranteed wage floors.
REC-OPS-FLT-001.confidence_caveat: Fleet ratios are audited from historical data; live dynamic dispatch requires live telematics integration.
